translations.web: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
translations.bsb: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.
translations.kjv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
